changeSet.author: vladimir.gjorgieski
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE USERS ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE, email VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, password VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, first_name VARCHAR(100), last_name VARCHAR(100), created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

changeSet.author: vladimir.gjorgieski
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE CART_ITEMS ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, product_id BIGINT NOT NULL, quantity INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE );

changeSet.author: vladimir.gjorgieski
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE FAVORITE_PRODUCTS ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, product_id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE );

changeSet.author: vladimir.gjorgieski
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE BUYERS ( buyer_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, first_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, last_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(100) NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
